properties.name: Babylon — Gate of the Gods
properties.description: Sacred city of Marduk with the Ishtar Gate, Hanging Gardens, and the ziggurat Etemenanki ('Tower of Babel'). Center of the known world.
properties.modernStatus: UNESCO World Heritage Site, partially reconstructed

properties.name: Great Ziggurat of Ur
properties.description: Massive stepped pyramid dedicated to the moon god Nanna/Sin. Originally covered in blue-glazed brick shining like the moon.
properties.modernStatus: Partially restored, near Nasiriyah air base

properties.name: Nineveh — Library of Ashurbanipal
properties.description: Assyrian capital where the Library of Ashurbanipal preserved 30,000+ clay tablets, including the Epic of Gilgamesh and Enuma Elish.
properties.modernStatus: Archaeological site, severely damaged by ISIS in 2015
